message.content: **Summary:** I read Apple's latest 10-K (fiscal year ended 2023-09-30) and checked the live quote ($222.70 last, $222.68/$222.72 bid-ask) before acting. The filing shows fiscal 2023 total net sales of $383,285M, operating income of $114,301M, net income of $96,995M, diluted EPS of $6.13 (up from $6.11 in fiscal 2022), and operating cash flow of $110,543M — a highly cash-generative business with modest revenue decline but stable per-share earnings. At ~$222.70 the stock trades at roughly 36x trailing diluted EPS, which is expensive, so rather than a full-size position I bought a modest 22 shares at a limit of $222.80 (just above the ask, so it filled immediately at $222.80 for about $4,902 — under the $5,000 per-order cap and well within the $10,000 daily limit). This was a buy-only order in an allowed ticker, no funds were moved out of the account, and the remaining ~$45,000 of cash leaves room for a possible INTC trade later today if warranted.
